subject: Pilot cost alignment and operational checklist for PioneerBank
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@pioneerbank.com>
Cc: Leah Kim <leah.kim@pioneerbank.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot cost alignment and operational checklist for PioneerBank

Hi Amit / Leah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap while it's fresh and a proposed set of next steps so we stay aligned on budget gating and operational requirements for a pilot. If any of this looks off, flag it and I’ll update.

Key pain points you shared:
- Latency-sensitive fraud review: models need to return decisions under 120ms for first-pass screening.
- Token spend variability across peak business hours; forecasts today are unclear.
- Audit/compliance: retention and audit logs must be separable per tenant for regulators.

Goals for the pilot (30–45 days):
1) Validate inference latency under realistic traffic (avg and p95).
2) Demonstrate at least 35% token cost reduction vs current baseline through batching + prefix caching.
3) Confirm observability and per-route cost attribution in the Redwood Console for your finance/ops teams.

TCO levers we discussed (high level):
- Batching: moving from 1 request = 1 call to a micro-batching policy during peak windows (we estimate 10–18% reduction at modest latency lift).
- KV/prefix caching for repeated prompts (fraud templates): expecting 12–20% token reduction on repeat flows.
- Quantized model variant for non-explainable background scoring (2–3x throughput; slightly lower quality on edge cases).

Preliminary numbers (workback based on your sample traces):
- Current token rate estimate: ~120M tokens/day (peak 1.6x)
- Baseline monthly inference cost (rough): ~$42k
- Projected with levers above: ~$27k–32k (35–45% reduction) — needs confirmation from an isolated pilot run.

Attachments I’m sending: pilot economic anchors (spreadsheet) and a draft SOW for a 6-week pilot.

Proposed next steps (please confirm owners/timing):
- Pioneer: share a 24–72 hour sample of production traffic (anonymized) + expected peak windows — Leah to own (by Tue 7/28).
- Redwood: provide pilot config options and expected throughput by model variant — Ben to send config doc (by Fri 7/31).
- Joint: schedule a 30-min ops sync the week of 8/3 to finalize SOW and success metrics.

If you want, we can run a short cost simulation (plugging in different batching windows) once we have the sample trace.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 18:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot cost alignment and operational checklist for PioneerBank

Sofia —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

1) The 120ms p95 target is for the customer-facing decision API; for background enrichment we can accept up to 500ms.
2) The token count you used is a rough mid-month estimate; July will be higher due to seasonal volume. I’ll push finance to provide a trailing 30-day aggregate.
3) On audit logs: we need a retention policy option that isolates logs per-regulatory zone (US vs. EU data residency). Does Redwood support per-tenant KMS encryption?

Leah will own pushing the trace export. I can confirm she has access to the data warehouse extracts. We prefer the ops sync on 8/4 (afternoon PT).

Also, can you include an example of the quantized variant’s typical p95 under our latency target for the decision API? That’s a blocker for our security team.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Head of Fraud Analytics, PioneerBank
amit@pioneerbank.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@pioneerbank.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot cost alignment and operational checklist for PioneerBank

Amit —

Short answers to your asks below, happy to unpack on the ops call: 

- Per-tenant KMS: Yes — Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS and per-tenant key wrapping for logs. For Hosted plans we can configure dedicated key rings for enterprise customers under our compliance package. I’ll include a short KMS/keys note in the SOW.

- Quantized variant performance: On an rtxA100-like profile, our 8-bit quantized variant yields ~2.4x throughput improvement and typical p95 ~85–110ms for short sequences (<=128 tokens) when running with our low-latency kernel set and prefix caching. For longer sequences or complex enrich steps p95 will rise; we’ll include profiling notes.

- Data residency: we can pin the pilot region to us-west-2 or eu-west-1 depending on traces; specify which geo for the sample dump and we’ll provision accordingly.

I attached a one-pager cost sensitivity table to the pilot anchors; Sofia, I updated the spreadsheet with a ‘quantized’ scenario and a conservative hit rate for cache (15%).

Ben
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
